يسترحموا (form X)
# يَسْتَرْحِمُوا (yastarḥimū) /jas.tar.ħi.muː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَرْحَمَ (istarḥama)
# يُسْتَرْحَمُوا (yustarḥamū) /jus.tar.ħa.muː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَرْحَمَ (istarḥama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
